Nora (CS): IvyCare renewal is blocked — PO uploaded but payment term requested is Net10 and our contract is Net30. Also signer on PO is procurement lead, not CFO. Need quick path to get seats live today.
Diego (Sales): Eve says AP insists on Net10 for new integrations. Can finance accept Net10 for first invoice if we get CFO email confirmation?
Eve (IvyCare): Hi all — apologies. Our AP auto-applies Net10 for vendors in our onboarding bucket. We can get CFO sign-off but CFO is in meetings until 2pm. Procurement uploaded PO: https://files.ivycare.example/IC-PO-556.pdf
Hannah (Finance): Net10 is tight but we'll accept Net10 for the initial invoice only if: 1) CFO replies to this thread confirming Net10 for invoice dated 2026-04-05, and 2) PO maps to the billing entity on contract. We'll need a short amendment later to record the temporary term.
Mark (Legal): Agreed. Legal needs either CFO signature on amendment or an emailed delegation if someone else is signing. We should use a 30-day amendment template to formalize terms after invoicing.
Eve (IvyCare): Uploading CFO email now.
Eve (IvyCare): "I, Raul Mehta (CFO), approve Net10 for the initial invoice dated 2026-04-05 and confirm PO IC-PO-556 maps to IvyCare Ltd (VAT: GB44556677)." Attached signed scan.
DocuSign Bot: Created envelope env-ic-556 status=sent
Nora (CS): Updating envelope invoice field to IC-PO-556 and recipient to Raul Mehta. Resent. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-ic-556
DocuSign Bot: Envelope env-ic-556 status=completed
Billing Bot: Invoice created referencing IC-PO-556, term Net10, due 2026-04-15.
Hannah (Finance): Invoice processed. We'll require the amendment (Net10 initial invoice only) signed within 15 business days; otherwise future invoices revert to Net30.
Diego (Sales): Noted — I'll follow up with IvyCare to sign the amendment. Action: Sales to attach amendment template and CS to add note in CRM about Net10 exception.
Nora (CS): Closing loop — renewal executed, seats can be enabled. Risk: aggressive AP terms plus signer changes cause same-day blockers; recommend capture of AP term policies during renewal outreach. :memo:
Eve (IvyCare): Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround!
